scope: Cloud pinned-image STEP datum proof, pair assembly preview, development export and independent package verification; nominal CAD only, no order, no supplier upload
chain_script:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/user/zudo-pd
export PYTHONHASHSEED=0 D=scripts/pcb/board-b20 OUT=boards/board-b20-draft
V=manufacturing/verification/pd20-native-d2-layout-20261114
cp tmp/d2/after-unfilled.kicad_pcb tmp/d2v/after-unfilled.kicad_pcb
git show main:boards/board-b20-draft/board-b20-draft.kicad_pcb > tmp/d2v/before.kicad_pcb
python3 $D/finalize_refill.py tmp/d2v/after-unfilled.kicad_pcb $OUT/board-b20-draft.kicad_pcb --project $OUT/board-b20-draft.kicad_pro --receipt $OUT/refill-finalization.json > $V/refill-finalization.log 2>&1
A="--refs C44,C45,CDG12,CDG5,D4,D5,Q13,Q7,Q8,Q9,R81,R82,RDG12,RDG5,RSQ1,RSQ2,RSQ3,RSQ4,RXN2,RXN3 --replace Q51,Q52,Q55,RX12,RX5,R76 --field-sync R61,R62 --reach-mm 12 --added-reach-mm 26"
python3 $D/verify-insert-parts.py tmp/d2v/before.kicad_pcb tmp/d2v/after-unfilled.kicad_pcb $A --output $V/insert-verification-unfilled.json > /dev/null
python3 $D/verify-insert-parts.py tmp/d2v/before.kicad_pcb $OUT/board-b20-draft.kicad_pcb $A --output /dev/null > $V/insert-verification-filled.log 2>&1 || true
python3 $V/edit-region.py tmp/d2v/before.kicad_pcb $V/insert-verification-unfilled.json $V/edit-region.json
uv run -q --python 3.12 --with shapely python $V/fill-slit-check.py tmp/d2v/before.kicad_pcb $OUT/board-b20-draft.kicad_pcb $V/edit-region.json tmp/d2v/fill-slit-check.json > tmp/d2v/fill-slit.log
python3 -c "
import json;r=json.load(open('tmp/d2v/fill-slit-check.json'));v=r.pop('non_slit_vertices');r['non_slit_vertices_largest_50']=sorted(v,key=lambda x:-x['distance_to_other_fill_boundary_mm'])[:50]
json.dump(r,open('$V/fill-slit-check.json','w'),indent=1)"
T=tmp/d2v/rep; mkdir -p $T; git show main:$OUT/report-input-receipt.json > $T/report-template.json
tmp/d2/kpy.sh $D/dump-geom.py $OUT/board-b20-draft.kicad_pcb 2>/dev/null > $T/final-geom.json
tmp/d2/kpy.sh $D/read-routed-copper.py $OUT/board-b20-draft.kicad_pcb $T/report-template.json $T/final-geom.json $T/final-routes.json $OUT/report-input-receipt.json 2>&1 | grep -v Debug
python3 $D/loop-check.py $T/final-geom.json $T/final-routes.json $OUT/loop-check.json > /dev/null
python3 $D/current-check.py $T/final-geom.json $T/final-routes.json $OUT/current-check.json > /dev/null
python3 $D/thermal-check.py $OUT/thermal-check.json > /dev/null
python3 -c "
import json;p='$OUT/routing-report.json';r=json.load(open(p));d=json.load(open('$OUT/report-input-receipt.json'));r['tracks'],r['vias']=d['native_track_count'],d['native_via_count'];open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(r,indent=1)+'\n');print(r['tracks'],r['vias'])"
python3 $D/power-report.py > /dev/null
tmp/d2/kpy.sh tmp/d2/dump.py $OUT/board-b20-draft.kicad_pcb tmp/d2v/final-geom.json >/dev/null 2>&1
python3 $V/loop-resistance.py tmp/d2v/final-geom.json > $V/loop-resistance.txt
uv run --python 3.12 --with cadquery==2.6.1 --with vtk==9.3.1 python scripts/pcb/verify-step-datums.py --output tmp/step-datum-check.json > tmp/d2x/1-step-datum.log 2>&1
cp tmp/step-datum-check.json footprints/kicad/step-datum-verification.json
rm -rf tmp/pd20-d2-assembly
uv run --python 3.12 --with cadquery==2.6.1 --with vtk==9.3.1 python scripts/pcb/board-b20/assembly-preview.py --kicad-cli $PWD/tmp/cloud-kicad-tools/kicad-cli --kicad-python $PWD/tmp/cloud-kicad-tools/kicad-python --output "$PWD/tmp/pd20-d2-assembly" > tmp/d2x/2-assembly-preview.log 2>&1
rm -rf $OUT/assembly-preview && cp -a tmp/pd20-d2-assembly $OUT/assembly-preview
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,hashlib,os
p='manufacturing/local-only-assembly-previews.json';d=json.load(open(p))
f='boards/board-b20-draft/assembly-preview/populated-stack.step'
for k in d:
    if isinstance(d[k],list):
        for e in d[k]:
            if e.get('path')==f: e['sha256']=hashlib.sha256(open(f,'rb').read()).hexdigest();e['bytes']=os.path.getsize(f)
open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\n')
PY
rm -rf tmp/pd20-dev-export-d2
python3 scripts/pcb/export-jlcpcb.py tmp/pd20-dev-export-d2 --boards board-p board-b20-draft --kicad-cli $PWD/tmp/cloud-kicad-tools/kicad-cli --kicad-python $PWD/tmp/cloud-kicad-tools/kicad-python > tmp/d2x/3-export.log 2>&1
uv run -q --python 3.12 --with gerbonara --with resvg-py python scripts/pcb/verify-jlcpcb.py --write tmp/pd20-dev-export-d2 > tmp/d2x/4-verify.log 2>&1
echo CHAIN PASS
